title: Merge Intervals
statement:
Given an array of intervals where each interval is represented as [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals into a single interval. Return an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input.

Two intervals [a,b] and [c,d] overlap if a <= d and c <= b.

visibleExamples.explanation: Intervals [1,3] and [2,6] overlap, so they merge into [1,6].
Intervals [1,4] and [4,5] overlap at point 4, so they merge into [1,5].
No intervals overlap, so return all intervals as-is.
